_doc: Ruby overlay of data/hoenn_trainer_data.json (version.load_json deep merge). Generated by converter/gen_trainers.py with HOENN_VERSION=ruby: the 28 trainers that differ, under the Sapphire constant (same Black 2 id) and under Ruby's own; "ruby_trainer" / "sapphire_twin" name the pair.

TRAINER_ARCHIE_2.name: Maxie
messages: I...\nI lost again?

TRAINER_ARCHIE_3.name: Maxie
messages: What?!{be01}\nI, Maxie, was caught off guard?!

TRAINER_COURTNEY_1.name: Courtney
messages: Ahahahaha!\nYou’re disgustingly strong!

TRAINER_COURTNEY_2.name: Courtney
messages: Ahahahaha!{be01}\nOuch!

TRAINER_GRUNT_1.name: Grunt
messages: Ayiyiyi!\nSuspicious character spotted!{be01}
Grrrrr...\nI lost it!
I took the loss for the Team, but\nI did my job...

TRAINER_GRUNT_13.name: Grunt
messages: Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?

Our Boss says, “It will make everyone
happy.”{be01}
But why does everyone keep getting
in our way?

TRAINER_GRUNT_15.name: Grunt
messages: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!

TRAINER_GRUNT_16.name: Grunt
messages: Blast it...\nBlasted by a kid...
Our Boss knows everything.{be01}\nBut I’m just a Grunt. What would I know\nabout what he’s thinking?

TRAINER_GRUNT_17.name: Grunt
messages: The Institute created a type of\nPokémon that has something to do with{be00}\nthe weather. We’re here to take them!{be01}
Our plan’s being spoiled by a kid?
If the Pokémon they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of{be00}\nTeam Magma definitely need it!

TRAINER_GRUNT_18.name: Grunt
messages: We’re Team Magma!\nWe appear wherever anything rare is{be00}\nfound!{be01}
You got me!
You don’t have any idea what we of\nTeam Magma are working towards!{be00}\nYou stay out of our way!

TRAINER_GRUNT_19.name: Grunt
messages: Awaaaah!\nA kid beat me!
Oh, man, what a disaster...\nThe Boss is going to be furious...

TRAINER_GRUNT_2.name: Grunt
messages: If you want to know the secret about\nour Hideout, you have me to beat!{be01}
I can’t win at all...

TRAINER_GRUNT_20.name: Grunt
messages: What?!\nI lost, too!

Now what? If we don’t get the parts,
we’re in for it!{be01}
Arrgh, I didn’t count on being meddled
with by some meddling kid!

TRAINER_GRUNT_22.name: Grunt
messages: I’ll show you exactly how scary\nTeam Magma can be!{be01}
So you think you can stand up alone\nto Team Magma’s might...
Yeah, so you are strong...\nBut there’re a lot of us!

TRAINER_GRUNT_23.name: Grunt
messages: What’s up with you?\nWhat does a single kid expect to do?{be01}
Dang...\nToo strong...
You don’t know anything.\nQuit messing around with us!

TRAINER_GRUNT_24.name: Grunt
messages: Hey, I remember you from Mt. Chimney!\nIt’s payback time!{be01}
Urgggh...\nBeaten by some kid again!

Heh, it doesn’t matter!
We bought ourselves some time!{be01}
The Boss should have snatched what
he was after!

TRAINER_GRUNT_25.name: Grunt
messages: Huh?\nWhat’s a kid doing here?{be01}
Huh?\nI lost?!
Oh, no...\nI’ll catch an earful for losing to a kid...{be01}\nI should just take a nap in the bed...

TRAINER_GRUNT_26.name: Grunt
messages: Yawn... Keeping watch over the\nHideout bores me. I’ll take you on.{be01}
Yawn...\nOh, I lost...
If you scurry too much, other Team\nMagma members might get you.

TRAINER_GRUNT_27.name: Grunt
messages: What’s wrong with you?\nYou’re not tired at all!

That reminds me... I can’t remember
where I put the Master Ball.{be01}
If I fail to guard it, our Boss will
chew me out...

TRAINER_GRUNT_3.name: Grunt
messages: I took a serious licking!

TRAINER_GRUNT_30.name: Grunt

Tired of waiting...\nLost and dazed...
Boss...\nIs this good enough?

TRAINER_GRUNT_32.name: Grunt
messages: We don’t need a kid around!\nGo on home already!{be01}
I want to go home...
I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the Grunts...

TRAINER_GRUNT_33.name: Grunt
messages: That submarine... It’s tiny inside.\nI’m sore all over!{be01}
Losing makes me sore!
That submarine we jacked, man, it’s\nbrutal as a ride.{be00}\nIt’s way too tight in there!

TRAINER_GRUNT_34.name: Grunt
messages: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?{be01}
Lost it...
I can’t find the way out!{be01}\nI’m not afraid. Don’t get me wrong!
